question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and per-cache-hit disk snapshot reads as the health diagnostic tradeoff for this PR?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-proven, but tests cannot decide whether auth/provider path visibility to `operator.read` callers and synchronous disk reads on cached health responses are the desired operator contract.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact merge-result CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

options.title: Request Extra Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or health latency sample before merge if maintainers are not comfortable with drift path visibility or per-request disk reads.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want diagnostics and the hot-mode restart-policy change in the companion PR to land together.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact merge-result CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current-main owner signal for the central health cache and health payload path affected by the merge-risk choice.
